problem_statement: Calling mtd_read_page() or mtd_write_page() on an MTD device whose backend is mtd_mapper can result in an endless loop. The public mtd_read_page() and mtd_write_page() APIs must complete normally when reading or writing a valid page, returning 0 to indicate success, and must return -EOVERFLOW when the page index is out of range.

verification.reason: The statement specifies the public API names, the required success return value 0, and the -EOVERFLOW out-of-range behaviour checked by the hidden tests; the remaining data-transfer checks are implied by the existing public read/write page contract and discoverable from the repository.
